**Texere 0.4.6** · 11 November 2026

- **Fix: highlights are written into the PDF again.** With Texere's PDF++ settings, highlighting showed "PDF++: An error occurred while attempting to add an annotation": PDF++ needs an author name to write into the PDF, and 0.4.5 left it empty. Texere now sets it to your computer account's name (you can change it in PDF++ → Author). Vaults that already got 0.4.5 are fixed at the next start.

Also in this version (from 0.4.5): PDF++ comes ready with Texere's settings (colours as tags, auto-copy, auto-paste, copy formats); updates show up sooner, with What's new after any update.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
